gen-gf-bellota-gf-exo: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota draws every stroke with one stylus width and lets its s ends drift far from the spine. Exo follows in sans-serif, wide gaps keeping each line crisp and approachable down the page.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-google-sans-flex: Bold, quirky, hand-traced letters in Bellota, each stroke the width of one stylus, with s ends hanging far out. Google Sans Flex reads modern and tidy.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gruppo: Gruppo reads as a professional sans-serif, its curve endings staying well clear of each other. Bellota adds a commanding, unvarying line up top.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Bellota's s throws its ends far from the spine. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew then carries paragraphs in a contemporary sans-serif, its s and c mouths open and uncrowded, so text keeps a friendly, easy flow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP is a professional sans-serif whose curves each end in a clean, open gap. Bellota, meanwhile, keeps a monoline stroke from start to finish, so a long run of text feels approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-inclusive-sans: Those far-hanging s ends, traced at one stylus width, mark Bellota out at once. Inclusive Sans follows as a contemporary sans-serif, its round letters matching stem weight and keeping long text open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-istok-web: Approachable and modern, Istok Web is the quieter half here. Bellota brings r, n and m with arches matching their stems, while Istok Web, a sans-serif with clearly open sides, keeps extended reading smooth.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kumbh-sans: Pen-drawn and a little wild, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine. Kumbh Sans settles in below as a sans-serif with terminals cut short of the bowl, so paragraphs stay level and steady.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-manjari: Quirky, stylus-drawn Bellota leads, its s ends hanging far from the spine. Yet Manjari, with wide unclosed terminals, would hold up if the heading shrank, since its line weight stays steady.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-metrophobic: Hand-traced swagger comes from Bellota, every stroke at one stylus width and the s ends dangling away from the spine. Bellota is best at display; Metrophobic, a modern sans, handles text smoothly.
